chapters.label: CHAPTER 1
archiveLines: The town sleeps under a low autumn mist.
Public utility transmitters are broadcasting anomalous pulses across Roane County.
Verify your classified security clearance to access the emergency telemetry network.
chapters.completionLoreText: Project MKUltra records confirmed: psychic trials breached the dimensional veil beneath Hawkins Lab. Officer Callahan directs your team to Chief Hopper's evidence dossier.
completionLines: CLEARANCE CONFIRMED. Access granted to municipal dispatch telemetry.
Project MKUltra records confirm psychic trials breached the dimensional veil in November 1983.
Proceed to the Hawkins Police Department to examine Chief Hopper's incident board.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q1 · ITEM 01: SUBLEVEL 04 ANOMALY
questions.question: During the covert November 1983 incident at Hawkins National Laboratory, which classified Department of Energy project resulted in the initial psychokinetic rift and the escape of test subjects?
questions.hint: Callahan logged unusual psychokinetic activity near Sublevel 4 under MKUltra.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q2 · ITEM 02: RADIO INTERFERENCE FREQUENCY
questions.question: What radio frequency band was monitored by Hawkins Middle AV Club when receiving the first anomalous subspace broadcast?
questions.hint: Mr. Clarke helped the club assemble the Heathkit ham radio transceiver.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q3 · ITEM 03: MUNICIPAL GRID SURGE
questions.question: Which municipal utility experienced catastrophic power surging simultaneously with the gate opening?

options.text: Roane County Power Grid & North Elm Substation

questions.hint: Deputies noted voltage spikes tracking toward the DOE perimeter line.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q4 · ITEM 04: SUBJECT 011 PHYSIOLOGY
questions.question: What physiological indicator consistently accompanied Eleven's remote viewing and sensory deprivation tank sessions?
questions.hint: High psychokinetic output causes blood vessels in the nasal cavity to rupture.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q5 · ITEM 05: BENNY'S DINER FIRST SIGHTING
questions.question: Where was Subject 011 first spotted seeking refuge immediately following her escape from the lab perimeter?

options.text: The Palace Arcade on Main Street

questions.hint: Benny Hammond caught the young girl taking leftover fries from the kitchen.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q6 · ITEM 06: AV CLUB HEATHKIT TRANSCEIVER
questions.question: Which teacher at Hawkins Middle School provided the students with the high-powered Heathkit ham radio equipment?
questions.hint: Mr. Clarke always supported the boys' AV club curiosities and late-night calls.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q7 · ITEM 07: POWER SUBSTATION DRAW DROP
questions.question: What magnitude of power draw anomaly was logged across the municipal grid during the rift event?
questions.hint: Transformers blew across North Elm street causing town-wide flickering.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q8 · ITEM 08: DOE SURVEILLANCE VEHICLE COVERT ID
questions.question: What company logo was emblazoned on the Department of Energy surveillance vans intercepting telephone wiretaps?
questions.hint: The vans were disguised as routine power and light municipal trucks.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q9 · ITEM 09: MAGNETIC COMPASS DEVIATION
questions.question: What physical anomaly revealed the location of the dimensional gate when Dustin used his pocket compass?

options.text: Needles Deflected Toward Hawkins Lab (True Magnetic Anomaly)
Needles Froze Completely Solid Pointing South
Compass Glass Shattered under High Pressure

questions.hint: The massive electromagnetic tear drew compass needles away from True North.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q10 · ITEM 10: ELEVEN'S FAVORED RATION
questions.question: What grocery item did Eleven acquire during the Bradley's Big Buy incident to sustain her energy?

options.text: Boxes of Frozen Kellogg's Eggo Waffles
Three Bags of 3 Musketeers Chocolate Bars

questions.hint: She walked straight through the sliding glass doors carrying arms full of Eggos.

chapters.label: CHAPTER 2
archiveLines: Chief Hopper's office, Hawkins Police Department.
Eyewitness reports, dispatch audio logs, and sensor telemetry have been recovered.
Correlate the timestamps and radio recordings to identify the epicenter of the breach.
chapters.completionLoreText: All field reports and sensor vectors converge directly on Hawkins National Laboratory Sublevel 4. But first, urgent dispatches report lights communicating at the Byers residence.
completionLines: ANOMALY EPICENTER CONFIRMED · GROUND ZERO IDENTIFIED.
All telemetry vectors and field reports converge on Hawkins National Laboratory Sublevel 4.
Investigate the Byers residence where lights have begun communicating through the walls.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q1 · ITEM 01: ANOMALY EPICENTER
questions.question: Chief Hopper's incident board correlates witness reports, power station voltage drops, and RF interference. Which facility is the primary epicenter of the anomaly?
questions.hint: All field vectors and radio recordings converge directly on Hawkins Lab.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q2 · ITEM 02: MIRKWOOD ROADWAY RECON
questions.question: What vehicle was found abandoned near the Mirkwood perimeter road on the night Will Byers disappeared?
questions.hint: Found tipped over in the ditch with the headlight still faintly running.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q3 · ITEM 03: PERIMETER SLIME RESIDUE
questions.question: What chemical substance was discovered on the perimeter fences of the Department of Energy facility during morning recon?

options.text: Corrosive Biological Slime with Organic Spores

questions.hint: The biological mucus leaves glowing organic spore residues under UV light.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q4 · ITEM 04: DISPATCH RECON OFFICERS
questions.question: Which Hawkins Police Department officers assisted Chief Hopper in reviewing the surveillance logs from the main gate checkpoint?
questions.hint: Callahan and Powell are the two main deputies at the Hawkins precinct.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q5 · ITEM 05: MORGUE RECON AUTOPSY REPORT
questions.question: What shocking anomaly did Chief Hopper discover when he cut open the body recovered from Sattler Quarry in the county morgue?

options.text: The Body was a Counterfeit Stuffed with Cotton Batting
The Body was Completely Frozen in Carbonite
The Body was a Robotic Mannequin with Copper Wiring
The Internal Organs Were Transmuted into Ash

questions.hint: Hopper sliced into the stomach with a pocket knife and pulled out cotton stuffing.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q6 · ITEM 06: BENNY HAMMOND AUTOPSY CLASSIFICATION
questions.question: How did state investigators fraudulently rule the violent death of diner owner Benny Hammond?

options.text: Heart Attack Caused by Smoke Inhalation

questions.hint: Agent Frazier shot Benny and immediately staged a suicide note and pistol.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q7 · ITEM 07: STATE POLICE JURISDICTIONAL LOCKOUT
questions.question: Why were Chief Hopper and his deputies barred from approaching the quarry retrieval site?

options.text: Federal State Troopers Imposed Immediate Martial Clearance
A Broken Down Heavy Crane Blocking the Pass

questions.hint: Unknown federal troopers took command of the perimeter and pushed local police away.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q8 · ITEM 08: CHIEF'S VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION
questions.question: What vehicle model does Chief Jim Hopper operate as his official patrol command vehicle?
questions.hint: The beige and brown two-tone Chevrolet K5 Blazer with roof siren.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q9 · ITEM 09: RESIDENTIAL SURVEILLANCE BUG
questions.question: Where did Chief Hopper discover the covert listening device planted inside his cabin home?

options.text: Inside the Living Room Ceiling Light Fixture
Taped Behind the Kitchen Rotary Phone

questions.hint: He tore his house apart with a knife until finding the microphone in the lamp.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q10 · ITEM 10: PRECINCT EVIDENCE LOCKER #4
questions.question: What item recovered from the Mirkwood ditch was cataloged into the Hawkins evidence locker on Day 1?

options.text: Will's Stitched Winter Puffer Vest & Hand Flashlight
A Set of 20-Sided D&D Polyhedral Dice
A Torn Notebook Page of Mirkwood Maps

questions.hint: The vest and flashlight were gathered by search volunteers at sunrise.

chapters.label: CHAPTER 3
archiveLines: The Byers house stands isolated along the edge of Mirkwood.
Tangled strings of Christmas lights are illuminated on the living room wallpaper without any power connection.
Scrambled message fragments are strewn across the table. Reconstruct Will's urgent warning.
chapters.completionLoreTitle: WILL'S WARNING DECODED · 'DO NOT OPEN THE GATE'
chapters.completionLoreText: The message is assembled: 'DO NOT OPEN THE GATE'. The lights flicker violently toward Hawkins National Laboratory. The Sublevel 3 mainframe has suffered telemetry parity overflow.
completionLines: WILL'S WARNING RESTORED: 'DO NOT OPEN THE GATE'.
Electromagnetic surge tracks directly toward the government facility.
Sublevel 3 mainframe has suffered telemetry parity overflow. Stabilize the routine.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q1 · ITEM 01: WALL INTERFACE ARRAY
questions.question: What household decoration did Joyce Byers string across the living room to establish direct alphabetic contact with Will?

options.text: 26 Multicolored Christmas String Lights (A through Z)

questions.hint: Joyce painted 26 English letters on the floral wallpaper beneath each bulb.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q2 · ITEM 02: URGENT WALL CIPHER
questions.question: What urgent warning did Will spell out through the wall lights before the Demogorgon burst through the wallpaper?
questions.hint: Three rapid pulses spelled out the single imperative word to flee.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q3 · ITEM 03: CASSETTE GROUNDING TRACK
questions.question: Which rock anthem did Jonathan play on his cassette deck in Will's bedroom to keep his spirits grounded?

options.text: The Clash — 'Should I Stay or Should I Go'

questions.hint: From Combat Rock (1982), Will sang this track while hiding in Castle Byers.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q4 · ITEM 04: DIMENSIONAL MEMBRANE
questions.question: What physical barrier anomaly formed behind the wallpaper when Joyce tried to reach through to her son?

options.text: A Vacuum Air Pocket with Freezing Frost

questions.hint: The wall stretched like elastic latex as the Upside Down intersected our world.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q5 · ITEM 05: ROTARY TELEPHONE ELECTRICAL DISCHARGE
questions.question: What occurred to the Byers kitchen rotary telephone during Will's first transmission attempt?

options.text: High-Voltage Overload Burned and Melted the Receiver Coils
The Cord Detached and Slithered like a Snake
A Piercing 20,000 Hz Ultrasound Shattered the Glass

questions.hint: Joyce heard breathing and static before an electrical blast melted the plastic handset.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q6 · ITEM 06: CASTLE BYERS SANCTUARY
questions.question: What outdoor structure in the woods served as Will's secret refuge before it was discovered by the predator?
questions.hint: A handmade wooden shelter marked by a painted wooden shingle sign.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q7 · ITEM 07: JOYCE'S DEFENSIVE WEAPON
questions.question: What tool did Joyce Byers clutch constantly while waiting in the armchair for the living room breach?
questions.hint: She chopped through the drywall with an axe when the wall began groaning.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q8 · ITEM 08: JONATHAN'S PHOTOGRAPHIC EVIDENCE
questions.question: What mysterious silhouette did Jonathan accidentally photograph in the woods behind Steve Harrington's home?

options.text: The Faceless Demogorgon Looming Near the Pool
A Department of Energy Hazmat Squad

questions.hint: His 35mm camera caught the elongated creature right before Barb disappeared.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q9 · ITEM 09: DOG BEHAVIORAL WARNING
questions.question: How did the Byers family dog alert the household to the approaching entity on the night of the breach?

options.text: Barking Frantically at the Empty Backyard Shed
Whimpering and Hiding Underneath Jonathan's Bed
Refusing to Step Onto the Front Porch Steps
Scratching Claw Marks Into the Living Room Floor

questions.hint: The dog barked hysterically at the shed as the outdoor floodlight flickered.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q10 · ITEM 10: WALLPAPER TEAR HEALING
questions.question: What happened to the physical living room wall after the Demogorgon pressed through and receded?

options.text: The Punctured Hole Rapidly Contracted and Resealed
It Left a Permanent 6-Foot Hole into Subzero Void
The Entire Wall Collapsed into Wooden Splinters
Liquid Slime Poured Out Flooding the Living Room

questions.hint: Like a living organic membrane, the tear knit back together once the entity pulled back.

chapters.label: CHAPTER 4
archiveLines: Hawkins National Laboratory. Sublevel 3 automated relay terminal accessed.
The telemetry packet router crashed due to an unhandled parity logic routine.
Inspect the routine, trace the data loop, and enter the output integer to restore transmission.
chapters.completionLoreText: Parity logic routine stabilized! Intercepted Department of Energy logs reveal anomalous coordinates carved into ancient pine trees along Deep Woods Trail 7.
completionLines: TELEMETRY BUFFER RESTORED · ROUTINE EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL.
Sublevel 3 parity routine stabilized. Grid telemetry active.
Follow the signal vector into the deep forest to find the carved trail markers.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q1 · ITEM 01: BUFFER PARITY ROUTINE
questions.question: In the Sublevel 3 telemetry router, what parity logic routine stabilized the crashed data packet buffer?

options.text: Double Even Integers (* 2) and Add 1 to Odds (+ 1)
Bitwise XOR Shift Right by 2 Bits
Invert Odd Bytes and Sum Modulo 256

questions.hint: Check the Hawkins Lab telemetry parity script in Sublevel 3.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q2 · ITEM 02: LEAD RESEARCH DIRECTOR
questions.question: Who was the senior research scientist overseeing Project Indigo and the psychokinetic child experiments at Hawkins Lab?
questions.hint: Brenner ran the classified sensory deprivation program throughout the 1970s and 1980s.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q3 · ITEM 03: SENSORY ISOLATION TANK
questions.question: What isolation apparatus was utilized in Hawkins Lab to amplify test subjects' extra-sensory perception into the Void?
questions.hint: Filled with hundreds of pounds of salt to allow complete zero-gravity floatation.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q4 · ITEM 04: FIRST GATE INTRUDER
questions.question: What creature first breached through the dimensional gate following Subject 011's psychic contact in the Void?
questions.hint: The humanoid creature with petal-like jaw mandibles entered our realm first.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q5 · ITEM 05: SUBLEVEL 4 ELEVATOR SHAFT HAZARD
questions.question: What environmental biological growth completely colonized the Hawkins Lab elevator shaft down to Sublevel 4?

options.text: Pulsating Fleshy Webbing and Toxic Tendrils

questions.hint: Thick vascular vines spread from the rift, choking the elevator cables.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q6 · ITEM 06: HAZMAT RECON TETHER INCIDENT
questions.question: What terrifying outcome occurred when hazmat scout Shepherd was tethered and sent into the rift on Sublevel 4?

options.text: His Steel Safety Cable Was Reeled Back Severed and Bloodied
His Radio Telemetry Transmitted Inverted Morse Code
He Returned Mutated with Insectoid Antennae
The Winch Motor Seized and Melted From Extreme Heat

questions.hint: The winch pulled back a snapped, mangled cable covered in creature slime.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q7 · ITEM 07: SUBLEVEL 3 MAINFRAME TERMINAL ID
questions.question: What computer operating system architecture was installed on the Sublevel 3 central surveillance mainframe?
questions.hint: The massive DEC VAX rack systems processed telemetry across the whole compound.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q8 · ITEM 08: THE VOID PSYCHIC TOPOGRAPHY
questions.question: How did Eleven visually perceive the astral plane of the Void during sensory immersion?

options.text: An Infinite Black Expanse with an Ankle-Deep Water Floor
A Dense Foggy Forest Illuminated by Crimson Lightning
A Endless White Room Without Doors or Shadows
A Cavern Filled with Suspended Red Spores

questions.hint: Pitch black silence with ripples forming under her footsteps.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q9 · ITEM 09: COLD WAR ESPIONAGE TARGET
questions.question: Who was Eleven tasked with eavesdropping on in the Void right before accidentally discovering the interdimensional creature?

options.text: A Soviet General Stationed Inside a Moscow Military Complex
A KGB Submarine Commander in the Pacific Ocean
An East German Stasi Cryptographer in Berlin
A Cuban Missile Telemetry Engineer in Havana

questions.hint: She recited Russian military transmissions into the lab's tape recorders.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q10 · ITEM 10: PERIMETER ALARM SENSOR CODE
questions.question: What alarm classification was triggered at Hawkins Lab when Eleven breached the gate and escaped through the drainage pipe?

options.text: Code Red: Bio-Containment Breach & Perimeter Alert
Code Blue: High Voltage Transformer Fault

questions.hint: Sirens echoed through the perimeter woods alerting Brenner's security forces.

chapters.label: CHAPTER 5
archiveLines: Deep woods near Trail 7. Autumn fog hangs thick among towering pines.
Flashlight beams reveal strange geometric runes carved into ancient tree trunks.
Extract the three glowing pine digits left-to-right to lock the vector coordinates.
chapters.completionLoreText: Trail coordinates 4 · 1 · 7 verified! The harmonic vector points directly to the high-altitude East Hill Radio Tower. Pip is waiting on frequency 14.3 MHz.
completionLines: FOREST RUNES DECODED: VECTOR 4 · 1 · 7.
Coordinates align with East Hill Radio Tower sublevel.
Ascend to the Radio Tower to calibrate the scrambled 5-pin radiometer.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q1 · ITEM 01: TREE PORTAL ANOMALY
questions.question: What tree landmark in Mirkwood concealed an organic portal into the Upside Down discovered by Nancy Wheeler?

options.text: Hollowed Rotting Sycamore Trunk with Dripping Slime
Overgrown Weeping Willow near Sattler Quarry

questions.hint: Nancy crawled through the pulsating fleshy opening inside the sycamore base.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q2 · ITEM 02: PREDATOR SCENT VECTOR
questions.question: What behavioral vulnerability was observed when tracking Demogorgon scent signatures through the forest?

options.text: Highly Attracted to the Scent of Fresh Blood
Drawn Exclusively to Bright Ultraviolet Light

questions.hint: A single drop of blood cuts through the dimensional barrier like a beacon.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q3 · ITEM 03: RUNIC VECTOR TRIANGULATION
questions.question: What runic vector pattern was marked on the three perimeter surveillance trees along Trail 7?
questions.hint: Extract the glowing red pine runes left-to-right to find vector 4-1-7.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q4 · ITEM 04: TRAP COUNTERMEASURES
questions.question: What makeshift countermeasures did Nancy Wheeler and Jonathan Byers prepare at the Byers house to trap the predator?

options.text: Bear Trap, Gasoline Fire, and Nail-Studded Bat

questions.hint: Steve Harrington joined with the nail-spiked Louisville Slugger bat.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q5 · ITEM 05: D&D ANALOG BEAST
questions.question: In Mike Wheeler's Dungeons & Dragons campaign, which two-headed monster piece was knocked over by Will's failed fireball roll?

options.text: The Thessalhydra with Eight Maw Heads

questions.hint: Will rolled a 7 on his twenty-sided die, failing to cast fireball.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q6 · ITEM 06: MIRKWOOD INTERSECTION ROAD SIGN
questions.question: What two rural roads cross at the infamous Mirkwood intersection near the lab fence line?
questions.hint: The boys nicknamed the desolate dark corner 'Mirkwood' from Tolkien's books.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q7 · ITEM 07: FLASHLIGHT AMBER SPORE EFFECT
questions.question: What floating phenomenon was visible in flashlight beams near the forest portal site?

options.text: Bioluminescent Amber Spores Drifting Slowly in Mid-Air
Black Ash Flakes Emitting Electrostatic Shocks
Green Iridescent Insects Swarming in Circles
Tiny Freezing Ice Needles Suspended Against Gravity

questions.hint: Particles suspended like underwater snow drifted outward through the portal opening.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q8 · ITEM 08: STEVE'S MODIFIED WEAPON
questions.question: What weapon modification did Jonathan construct on the Louisville Slugger baseball bat?

options.text: Hammered Rows of 2-Inch Steel Carpenter Nails
Wrapped Barbed Razor Wire Around the Barrel
Bolted Serrated Lawnmower Blades Along the Tip
Soaked Heavy Burlap in Gasoline for a Torch Bat

questions.hint: Steve swung the nail-studded bat in the living room to drive back the creature.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q9 · ITEM 09: TRAIL 7 COMPASS ROTATION
questions.question: How did the boys recognize they were approaching the laboratory's perimeter fence on Trail 7?

options.text: All Compass Needles Began Slowly Rotating Counter-Clockwise
Their Walkie-Talkies Emitted Static Morbid Whispers
The Pine Trees Lost All Needles and Turned Black
Ground Temperatures Dropped Below Zero Degrees

questions.hint: Dustin realized they were following a magnetic deviation towards the lab.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q10 · ITEM 10: WOUNDED DEER TRACKING
questions.question: What prey animal was dragged into the Sycamore tree portal right before Nancy climbed in?

options.text: A Wounded Forest Deer Shot by Local Hunters
A Stray Red Fox with a Injured Leg

questions.hint: Nancy and Jonathan tracked blood droplets from a deer until it vanished inside the tree.

chapters.label: CHAPTER 6
archiveLines: East Hill Radio Tower sublevel accessed.
The tower's emergency radiometer is scrambled by dimensional static.
Calibrate the carrier frequencies, align the waveform, and restore all 5 pins with Pip.
chapters.completionLoreText: All 5 pins locked into harmonic resonance! The master security code 8-3-4-7-9 has been recovered, unlocking the Gate rift leading into the Upside Down.
completionLines: ALL 5 PINS RESTORED. Master code 8-3-4-7-9 decoded.
Dimensional rift threshold stabilized across Roane County.
The threshold into the Upside Down is open. Prepare for Vecna.

VHF Military Repeater with Satellite Dish
Microwave Dish Link Aimed at Chicago

options.text: Toxic Airborne Spores & Localized Electromagnetic Storms

questions.hint: Calibrate all 5 pins on the tower radiometer to clear the distortion meter.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q4 · ITEM 04: PLANCK'S CONSTANT RELAY
questions.question: What mathematical constant was relayed via Cerebro from Utah to unlock the Russian subterranean vault?
questions.hint: Suzie required Dustin to sing 'The NeverEnding Story' before giving Planck's constant.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q5 · ITEM 05: WEATHERTOP TOPOGRAPHY ELEVATION

options.text: It is the Highest Unobstructed Elevation in Roane County
It Was Located Directly Above a Classified Military Bunker
It Provided Direct Access to the Municipal Power Grid
It Was Shielded from Russian Radar Detection

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q6 · ITEM 06: DUSTIN'S UTAH RADIO OPERATOR
questions.question: Who was Dustin attempting to establish contact with across the country over Cerebro's frequency?

options.text: Suzie Bingham from Camp Know Where
His Uncle Jack in Salt Lake City
An MIT Physics Ham Radio Station

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q7 · ITEM 07: RUSSIAN TRANSLATED CIPHER
questions.question: What riddle was recorded by Dustin's radio scanner while intercepting Russian communications in Hawkins?

options.text: 'The silver cat feeds when blue and yellow meet in the northeast'
'The iron bear sleeps under red stars near the river'
'Cold winter arrives when three clocks strike midnight'
'The black crow flies past the western grain elevator'

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q8 · ITEM 08: STARCOURT SUB-LEVEL FACILITY
questions.question: What covert installation was powered beneath Starcourt Mall utilizing intercepted municipal telemetry?

options.text: A Soviet Subterranean Laser Complex Drilling Open the Rift
A Chemical Weapons Biological Processing Plant

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q9 · ITEM 09: 14.8 MHZ TELEMETRY SPIKE
questions.question: What event causes the radio tower's signal meter to peg into maximum redline frequency spikes?

options.text: Physical Demogorgon Movement across the Dimension Membrane
Sunspot Solar Flares During Dusk Hours
Routine Police Dispatch Broadcasting on Channel 3

questions.hint: Subspace breaches emit intense RF noise across the 14.8 MHz frequency band.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q10 · ITEM 10: DECRYPTED MASTER OVERRIDE SEQUENCE
questions.question: What 5-digit cipher combination unlocks the final radio tower transmitter override circuit?
questions.hint: Aligning all 5 radiometer pins outputs the sequence 8-3-4-7-9.

chapters.label: CHAPTER 7

The ticking grandfather clock echoes across corrupted Hawkins.
Decode Experiment 001's scrubbed identity to sever Vecna's psychic hold on Hawkins.
chapters.completionLoreTitle: HAWKINS PROTOCOL COMPLETE · THE GATE SEALED
chapters.completionLoreText: Henry Creel's identity confirmed! The psychic feedback loop fractures Vecna's link. The dimensional gate seals shut. Hawkins is saved.
completionLines: HENRY CREEL IDENTIFIED. Subject 001 psychic link severed.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q8 · ITEM 08: VICTOR CREEL SURVIVAL FACTOR
questions.question: How did Victor Creel survive the psychic slaughter of his family in 1959 at the Creel House?

options.text: Ella Fitzgerald's 'Dream a Little Dream of Me' Played on the Radio
He Knocked Himself Unconscious on the Fireplace Hearth
The Local Police Arrived and Fired Flares
Young Henry Exhausted His Psychic Stamina and Fell Comatose

questions.hint: Music served as an anchor allowing Victor's mind to find the light and escape.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q9 · ITEM 09: EDDIE MUNSON ROOFTOP CONCERT
questions.question: What heavy metal masterpiece did Eddie Munson shred atop his Upside Down trailer to distract the Demobats?
questions.hint: Eddie played his black Warlock guitar with Dustin guarding the perimeter.

questions.subHeader: DEMO Q10 · ITEM 10: SOTERIA INHIBITOR CHIP
questions.question: What miniature device was surgically implanted inside Henry Creel's neck by Dr. Brenner to suppress his abilities?
questions.hint: Eleven used her powers to telekinetically extract the Soteria device from Henry's neck.
